aggregation_policy.continuous_errors: Pool signed pointwise errors over all four histories and all 1024 observation times, then report RMSE unless explicitly stated otherwise.
aggregation_policy.history_bias: Compute a signed mean error separately within each history, take its absolute value, then average those four absolute history biases. This prevents cancellation among histories.
aggregation_policy.timing: Use observation-step indices. If event-sequence cardinality differs, sequence mismatch is reported separately and timing receives the preregistered worst-case penalty of 1024 steps.

GW_LB.cumulative_bottom_exchange_error_cm: pooled RMSE of cumulative bottom downward exchange relative to R2048_T32
GW_LB.interval_bottom_flux_error_cm_per_day: pooled RMSE of observation-interval average bottom downward flux
GW_LB.bottom_flux_sign_mismatch_count: total sign mismatches over all histories and observations
GW_LB.reversal_sequence_mismatch_count: number of histories whose non-zero flux-sign reversal sequence has different cardinality
GW_LB.reversal_timing_error_steps: maximum absolute paired reversal-step difference over histories with matching sequence cardinality; 1024 if any sequence cardinality mismatches
GW_LB.total_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of total integrated profile storage
GW_LB.history_signed_bottom_flux_bias_cm_per_d: mean absolute per-history signed mean interval-bottom-flux error
GW_LB.long_horizon_exchange_drift_cm: maximum absolute final cumulative bottom-exchange error over histories

SURF_P.surface_0_20_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-20 cm storage
SURF_P.root_zone_0_40_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-40 cm storage
SURF_P.upper_0_80_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of integrated 0-80 cm storage
SURF_P.mapped_10cm_theta_error: pooled RMSE of water content mapped to sixteen fixed 10-cm bins
SURF_P.total_storage_error_cm: pooled RMSE of total integrated profile storage
SURF_P.storage_extremum_timing_error_steps: maximum absolute observation-step difference for minima and maxima of 0-40 and 0-80 cm storage, across histories
SURF_P.history_signed_storage_bias_cm: mean absolute per-history signed mean total-storage error

placement_decision.PLACEMENT_SUPPORTED: Purpose-aligned partition is <= U4 on every frozen metric within equality tolerance and strictly lower on at least one metric, separately per material.
placement_decision.UNIFORM_NONINFERIOR: U4 is <= purpose-aligned partition on every frozen metric and strictly lower on at least one metric, separately per material.

numerical_comparator.rule: Candidate crosses the numerical comparator only if it is componentwise no worse than R512_T32 relative to R2048_T32 on the complete purpose vector.
